messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Art. 3

Article 3 Specific Directives Where, for machinery, the hazards referred to in Annex I are wholly or partly covered more specifically by other Community Directives, this Directive shall not apply, or shall cease to apply, to that machinery in respect of such hazards from the date of implementation of those other Directives.

response.text:
this Directive | does not apply to | machinery in respect of such hazards | where the Annex I hazards are wholly or partly covered more specifically by other Community Directives | this Directive shall not apply, or shall cease to apply, to that machinery in respect of such hazards
this Directive | ceases to apply to | machinery in respect of such hazards | from the date of implementation of those other Directives | shall cease to apply, to that machinery in respect of such hazards from the date of implementation of those other Directives
hazards referred to in Annex I | are covered more specifically by | other Community Directives | for machinery, wholly or partly | the hazards referred to in Annex I are wholly or partly covered more specifically by other Community Directives
